printf '"'%s\\n' '--- receipt commit/base checks and scoped diffs ---'
check_receipt() {
  task="'$1; base=$2; merge=$3; shift 3
  printf '"'TASK %s\\n' \""'$task"
  printf '"'  base=%s type=%s\\n' \""'$base" "$(git cat-file -t "$base" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
  printf '"'  merge=%s type=%s\\n' \""'$merge" "$(git cat-file -t "$merge" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
  printf '"'  parents='; git show -s --format='%P' \""'$merge" 2>/dev/null || true; echo
  names=$(git diff --name-only "$base" "$merge")
  printf '"'  diff_names:\\n%s\\n' \""'$names"
  printf '"'  diff_stat:\\n'; git diff --stat \""'$base" "$merge"
  bad=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -z "$p" ] && continue
    allowed=0
    for a in "$@"; do [ "$p" = "$a" ] && allowed=1; done
    [ "$allowed" -eq 1 ] || { echo "  OUT_OF_SCOPE $p"; bad=1; }
  done <<EOF
$names
EOF
  [ -n "$names" ] && nonempty=true || nonempty=false
  printf '"'  nonempty=%s out_of_scope=%s\\n' \""'$nonempty" "$bad"
}
